ic_name: HDMI / DVI TMDS (TI TFP410 PanelBus Digital Transmitter — subset)

fsm_states.name: IDLE
fsm_states.description: Bus free; SDA and SCL both HIGH (released by all devices).

fsm_states.name: START_DETECT
fsm_states.description: Master generates HIGH→LOW on SDA while SCL HIGH; bus becomes busy.

fsm_states.name: ADDR_TRANSMIT
fsm_states.description: Master transmits 7-bit slave address + R/W bit; 8 SCL pulses.

fsm_states.name: ADDR_ACK_WAIT
fsm_states.description: 9th SCL pulse: master releases SDA; addressed slave pulls SDA LOW to ACK.

fsm_states.name: DATA_TRANSMIT
fsm_states.description: Transmitter (master or slave depending on R/W) drives 8 data bits MSB-first on SDA.

fsm_states.name: DATA_ACK_WAIT
fsm_states.description: 9th SCL pulse: receiver pulls SDA LOW for ACK or leaves HIGH for NACK.

fsm_states.name: CLOCK_STRETCH
fsm_states.description: Slave holds SCL LOW to delay next byte (optional handshake).

fsm_states.name: ARBITRATION_LOSS
fsm_states.description: Master detected SDA actual LOW while it drove HIGH; turns off SDA driver; falls back to slave mode if it has one.

fsm_states.name: STOP_GENERATE
fsm_states.description: Master generates LOW→HIGH on SDA while SCL HIGH; bus free.

fsm_states.name: REPEATED_START
fsm_states.description: Master generates new START without intervening STOP; keeps bus busy.

fsm_hints.trigger: TFP410 begins TMDS transmission when PD=1 AND PLL is locked AND (TDIS=0 OR no TDIS bit set). Receiver begins decoding when it sees a valid TXC clock and locks on control-character alignment during blanking.
fsm_hints.rule: DE input (or DE_GEN-internal DE) selects between active-video encoding (8→10 transition-minimised + DC-balance) and blanking encoding (control characters with VSYNC/HSYNC/CTL[3:1]). The same per-channel 10-bit symbol stream carries both; receiver disambiguates by transition density and reserved codes.
fsm_hints.abort: PD=0 or TDIS=1 gates TMDS outputs to V_OFF immediately; loss of HPD or RSEN may cause host to gate output at a higher protocol layer.

anti_deadlock_rule: TFP410 is a unidirectional TMDS transmitter — there is no arbitration on the TMDS pairs (point-to-point source-only). The I2C interface uses standard I2C arbitration (open-drain + ACK/NAK). HPD and RSEN are sample-only inputs from the receiver side. No multi-master deadlock paths exist on TMDS.
exit_from_reset: After reset, the device must release both SDA and SCL (both HIGH). Master can begin a transaction only when both lines are HIGH (bus free). Bus-clear procedure: if SDA stuck LOW, master sends 9 SCL pulses to allow the stuck device to release.

default_ready_state_recommendation.ACK_receiver_pull: Receiver pulls SDA LOW only during the 9th SCL pulse.
default_ready_state_recommendation.Clock_stretch: Slave holds SCL LOW after the 8th ACK pulse to delay next byte if it needs time.
default_ready_state_recommendation.TX_outputs_idle: V_OFF = AV_DD (both TX+ and TX- pulled to AV_DD by current-mode driver-off state); differential = 0 mV.
default_ready_state_recommendation.IDCK_idle: Static (no transitions); PLL loses lock; receiver de-asserts internal lock indicator.
default_ready_state_recommendation.DE_idle: Active-low blanking (DE=0); TMDS would encode control characters if PLL is locked.
default_ready_state_recommendation.I2C_idle: SCL high, SDA high (open-drain with external 5 kΩ pull-up).
default_ready_state_recommendation.HPD_idle_when_no_receiver: LOW (1 kΩ pull-down at receiver side or no driver).

channel_dependency_rules_master.note: Master generates START / STOP / repeated START; drives SCL; drives SDA during address byte and during write data bytes; releases SDA during read data bytes for slave to drive.

channel_dependency_rules_slave.note: Slave samples SDA on rising edge of SCL; drives SDA during read data bytes; may pull SCL LOW to clock-stretch; may NACK to indicate inability to continue.

arbitration_rule: Bit-by-bit on SDA while SCL HIGH: each master checks SDA level matches what it sent. First master to drive SDA HIGH while another drives LOW loses arbitration and switches off its SDA driver. No information is lost — the winning master's transaction continues normally.
synchronization_rule: Clock synchronization via wired-AND on SCL: combined SCL LOW period = longest LOW among contending masters; combined SCL HIGH period = shortest HIGH among contending masters.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_POWER_DOWN
fsm_states_transmitter.description: PD=0 — digital I/O + I2C alive; PLL, encoders, drivers gated; TX outputs at V_OFF.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_PLL_LOCK
fsm_states_transmitter.description: After PD=1, PLL locks to IDCK; few µs lock time.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_BLANKING
fsm_states_transmitter.description: DE=low. Encode control characters on TX0/TX1/TX2 with HSYNC/VSYNC/CTL.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_ACTIVE_VIDEO
fsm_states_transmitter.description: DE=high. Encode 8→10 transition-minimised + DC-balanced video character per channel.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_DISABLED_TDIS
fsm_states_transmitter.description: TDIS=1 — TMDS muted but PLL stays locked.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_DE_GEN_RUNNING
fsm_states_transmitter.description: DE_GEN=1 — internal DE generator drives DE from HSYNC/VSYNC + offsets.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_CHAR_ALIGN
fsm_states_receiver.description: Receiver hunts for control character codes during DE=low blanking to align 10-bit symbols.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_VIDEO_DECODE
fsm_states_receiver.description: Receiver decodes 10b → 8b; recovers R/G/B per pixel.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_BLANKING_DECODE
fsm_states_receiver.description: Receiver decodes control characters; recovers HSYNC/VSYNC + CTL[3:1].

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_HPD_DRIVE
fsm_states_receiver.description: Receiver drives HPD HIGH when powered + connected.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_EDID_SERVE
fsm_states_receiver.description: Receiver serves EDID over I2C at DDC address 0xA0/0xA1.

exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on: supplies ramp; ISEL/RST tied to system reset. When ISEL HIGH, I2C enabled; registers go to defaults (PD=0). Host MUST write CTL_1_MODE.PD=1 to enable TMDS.

stage_1_input_to_cascaded: 2. if (N1 > 4) OR (N1 == 4 AND D[0] == 0) → XNOR cascade: q[i] = q[i-1] XNOR D[i]; q[8]=0.
3. else → XOR cascade: q[i] = q[i-1] XOR D[i]; q[8]=1.
stage_2_disparity_balance: 3. Invert q[7:0] if needed; q[9]=1 if inverted; else 0.

control_character_state_machine.channel_1_TX1: Map {CTL[1], 0} similarly using the same 4 control-character codes.
control_character_state_machine.channel_2_TX2: Map {CTL[3], CTL[2]} — CTL[3] is forced to 0 (HDCP reserved); only CTL[2] is user-controllable in DVI mode.
control_character_state_machine.selector: DE=low → emit control character; DE=high → emit 8→10 transition-minimised video character.

configurations.name: Differential clock only in low-swing mode
configurations.description: Spec note: differential clock only when V_REF ≤ 0.9 V.

configurations.name: Continuous IDCK
configurations.description: IDCK runs continuously; PLL stays locked.

timing_dependency_rule: Source drives IDCK (SE or differential). DATA[23:0] + DE + sync + CTL[3:1] are latched on EDGE-selected IDCK+ edge with t_su(IDR) ≥ 1.2 ns / t_h(IDR) ≥ 1.3 ns (single-edge). Internal PLL multiplies IDCK by 10× for bit clock. Serializer shifts 10 bits per IDCK period per channel.
